title: Ghost in the Shell: SAC_2045

episodes_data.title: Ghost in the Shell: SAC_2045 1x1
episodes_data.description: The United States, 2045. Working as mercenaries, the Major and her team, including newbie Stan, defend a gated town from outlaws. Togusa takes a call.

episodes_data.title: Ghost in the Shell: SAC_2045 1x2
episodes_data.description: Armed by a generous patron, the Nomads attack Section 9 with AI drones. Togusa accepts a new mission from Japan's peace-seeking Prime Minister.

episodes_data.title: Ghost in the Shell: SAC_2045 1x3
episodes_data.description: As Togusa dives into cyberspace to track his former team members, the group is detained by a mysterious American organization seeking to employ them.

episodes_data.title: Ghost in the Shell: SAC_2045 1x4
episodes_data.description: While researching the team's disappearance and John Smith, Togusa takes a calculated risk. The GHOST members question the true nature of their mission.

episodes_data.title: Ghost in the Shell: SAC_2045 1x5
episodes_data.description: Aramaki sets off after Kusanagi in a race against time. GHOST begin their assignment, but Huge's cybernetic security forces them to alter their plans.

episodes_data.title: Ghost in the Shell: SAC_2045 1x6
episodes_data.description: Following the Section 9 reunion, Kusanagi and her colleagues learn about the "post-humans," a previously unknown threat to humanity.

episodes_data.title: Ghost in the Shell: SAC_2045 1x7
episodes_data.description: Back in Japan after six years, Batou decides to take a break while waiting for his delayed team. Then some amateur bank robbers interrupt his fun.

episodes_data.title: Ghost in the Shell: SAC_2045 1x8
episodes_data.description: The Major and Smith clash over Section 9's new mission hunting post-humans. She orders Togusa to investigate a suspected spy near the Prime Minister.

episodes_data.title: Ghost in the Shell: SAC_2045 1x9
episodes_data.description: Problems arise for Section 9 after one of the three post-humans in Japan murders several politicians, then targets the Prime Minister's father-in-law.

episodes_data.title: Ghost in the Shell: SAC_2045 1x10
episodes_data.description: Section 9 investigates a possible post-human hacker who uses the web to incite physical attacks on people. The trail leads to a high school student.

episodes_data.title: Ghost in the Shell: SAC_2045 1x11
episodes_data.description: Pudding helps analyze the Thinkpol program while the Major and Togusa search for clues about the post-human middle school student Takashi Shimamura.

episodes_data.title: Ghost in the Shell: SAC_2045 1x12
episodes_data.description: Togusa has a strange episode while analyzing the data confiscated from Shimamura. When he wakes up, he and Batou head out to investigate.

episodes_data.title: Ghost in the Shell: SAC_2045 2x1
episodes_data.description: Members of Section 9 seek out a man named Philip Kukushkin, a Russian national who seems to know a lot about the creation of posthumans.

episodes_data.title: Ghost in the Shell: SAC_2045 2x2
episodes_data.description: US special operations forces join the Section 9 team in their fight against a relentless posthuman named Suzuka Mizukane.

episodes_data.title: Ghost in the Shell: SAC_2045 2x3
episodes_data.description: While extracting information from Kukushkin, the Section 9 team uncovers some shocking information about an AI program developed by the US government.

episodes_data.title: Ghost in the Shell: SAC_2045 2x4
episodes_data.description: Worried Purin might be a spy for the Americans, the Major sends out a crew of Tachikoma to look into her hidden past.

episodes_data.title: Ghost in the Shell: SAC_2045 2x5
episodes_data.description: Togusa finally realizes that he's been trapped in his own memories — and suddenly finds himself in a devastated Tokyo in the year 2045.

episodes_data.title: Ghost in the Shell: SAC_2045 2x6
episodes_data.description: After hearing from Togusa, Batou and the others head to Tokyo. Back in Fukuoka, the Major learns that a posthuman has hijacked a nuclear submarine.

episodes_data.title: Ghost in the Shell: SAC_2045 2x7
episodes_data.description: Resurrected as a full-body prosthetic cyborg, Purin tries to hitchhike her way to Tokyo. US special operations forces face Mizukane's wrath.

episodes_data.title: Ghost in the Shell: SAC_2045 2x8
episodes_data.description: Batou and the group get an update on the posthuman situation from Standard. The Major and Purin join the rest of the crew in Tokyo.

episodes_data.title: Ghost in the Shell: SAC_2045 2x9
episodes_data.description: To take back control of the hijacked nuclear submarine, the Section 9 team targets Mizukane and Takashi Shimamura.

episodes_data.title: Ghost in the Shell: SAC_2045 2x10
episodes_data.description: Shimamura wakes up and makes a desperate move, putting Kusanagi and her crew in an impossible position.

episodes_data.title: Ghost in the Shell: SAC_2045 2x11
episodes_data.description: Kusanagi and her team do everything they can to stop the US from implementing their draconian plan to end the nuclear standoff with "N."

episodes_data.title: Ghost in the Shell: SAC_2045 2x12
episodes_data.description: The Section 9 crew start living their regular lives as if nothing ever happened — and the only one who finds it strange is Kusanagi.
